text: A pervasive relation based solely on negative concomitance is called exclusive negative concomitance. For example, earth is distinguished from other things by virtue of possessing fragrance. That which is not distinguished from others [in this manner] does not possess fragrance, such as water. This [object] is not like that; therefore, it is not [like water]. Here, there is no affirmative example stating "that which possesses fragrance is distinguished from others," because earth alone is the subject.
